record_title: Corrected critical-feedback equation and a three-halves edge law in feedback-trained recurrent networks
provenance: A source-specific correction and asymptotic refinement of the quasi-static dynamical mean-field critical-feedback equations in arXiv:2609.19288v1.
limitations: The exact expansions concern the source paper's quasi-static dynamical mean-field critical equations, not a certified finite-size network transition. The normalized-target q=1 crossing is floating-point quadrature. Broad priority for the three-halves exponent in random-network theory is not claimed.
